title: Woman Seated in Suburban Yard, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic mid-1940s black and white snapshot showing a young smiling woman sitting cross-legged in a metal lawn chair in a sunny front yard. She wears a tailored 1940s suit jacket with padded shoulders and casual shoes. In the background, a white picket fence, palm trees, suburban homes, and a period automobile are visible along the street.
